name: TLS certificate verification disabled
description: tls.Config.InsecureSkipVerify = true lets MITM read/modify traffic. Use proper CA bundle (x509.SystemCertPool or custom). CWE-295 (Improper Certificate Validation).

name: os/exec with shell interpolation
description: exec.Command("sh", "-c", stringWithArgs) or "bash" -c allows shell injection if strings contain metachars. Use exec.Command(name, args...) with no shell. CWE-78 (OS Command Injection).

name: Weak hash (md5/sha1) for security purposes
description: md5/sha1 is collision-prone; do not use for signatures, passwords, tokens. Use sha256/sha512 (hash/crc32 for integrity only). CWE-328 (Weak Hash).

name: Weak PRNG (math/rand) for secrets
description: math/rand is deterministic (seeded by time); do not use for tokens, salts, nonces. Use crypto/rand. CWE-338 (Use of Cryptographically Weak PRNG).

name: SQL query interpolated with user input
description: fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM x WHERE id=%s", in) is SQL injection. Use prepared statements: db.Query("SELECT ... WHERE id=?", in). CWE-89 (SQL Injection).

name: template.HTML unescaped user input
description: template.HTML(userInput) marks a string as safe and disables HTML escaping → XSS. Use text/template or html/template auto-escape. CWE-79 (XSS).

name: http/plaintext listener without TLS
description: net/http ListenAndServe on 0.0.0.0:80 or :80 without TLS terminates traffic in cleartext. Use http2/tls.Listen or a reverse proxy. CWE-319 (Cleartext Transmission).

name: JWT HS256 with weak / hardcoded secret
description: jwt.NewWithClaims(jwt.SigningMethodHS256, ...) with a hard-coded secret makes token forgery trivial. Load secret from env/KMS and rotate. CWE-798 (Hard-coded Credentials).

name: file permission 0777 / world-writable
description: os.Chmod(path, 0777) / os.OpenFile(..., 0666) leaves the file writable by everyone on multi-user hosts. Use 0640/0644 or stricter. CWE-732 (Incorrect Permission Assignment).

name: Hard-coded AWS / generic secret in Go source
description: AKIA[ASLOIDQW]{16} or long secret-looking string assigned to key/password/secret. Move to env or secrets manager. CWE-798 (Hard-coded Credentials).

name: unsafe pointer cast to interface
description: unsafe.Pointer / uintptr conversion used in non-internal code is a classic source of memory-safety bugs and GC bypass. Audit necessity. CWE-843 (Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type).
